fixture.scope: macOS artifact, workspace, simulator, lease, cleanup, and contamination subset only

benchmark_harness.invocation_rule: Invoke the fixture CLI; do not import its Go package.
required_metadata: mechanism Xcode SDK runtime and runner versions
primary state and secondary cache dimensions

execution_order.parallel_exception: Only the named bounded-concurrency probe may overlap namespaces.
execution_order.candidate_order: Freeze one deterministic order in the approved execution manifest before any result is observed.
execution_order.rerun_rule: Retain failed samples with cause. Rerun only after recording a contract-compatible operational correction; threshold misses are not rerun away.

timing_metrics.start: After a new manifest VM clone exists and before its first start command.
timing_metrics.end: Guest runner responds and full profile attestation succeeds.
timing_metrics.preparation: Create a new experiment VM clone from the unchanged local immutable base for every sample.

timing_metrics.start: Submit acquisition for already-warm attested capacity; queueing is measured separately and excluded.
timing_metrics.end: A unique empty workspace with namespace HOME TMPDIR DerivedData result roots and reset-policy attestation is ready to execute.
timing_metrics.preparation: Return capacity to its declared clean warm state and remove only the prior experiment sandbox before every sample.

timing_metrics.start: Acquire a simulator lease after workspace readiness using only the custom device set.
timing_metrics.end: The pinned device/runtime is booted, bootstatus reports ready, identity attestation passes, and installation service is reachable.
timing_metrics.preparation: Apply the candidate reset procedure within the custom device set before every sample.

timing_metrics.start: Begin pinned xcodebuild invocation after workspace and profile attestation.
timing_metrics.end: Declared IOSApp output and build log are closed and output manifest verification succeeds.
timing_metrics.preparation: Recreate namespace workspace; declare DerivedData and source/tool cache state explicitly before every sample.

timing_metrics.start: Begin installation of the verified IOSApp into the attested leased simulator.
timing_metrics.end: Installation command succeeds and the installed bundle identity matches the artifact manifest.
timing_metrics.preparation: Prepare the candidate-specific clean ready simulator before every sample.

timing_metrics.start: Launch the installed deterministic E06 mobile test after artifact simulator and lease attestation.
timing_metrics.end: Structured test report and diagnostics are closed and collected.
timing_metrics.preparation: Install the same verified build into a clean candidate-prepared simulator before every sample.

timing_metrics.start: Issue bounded reset after diagnostics are closed.
timing_metrics.end: All namespace mutable state is absent and the resource passes clean-state attestation for reuse.
timing_metrics.preparation: Seed only experiment-owned contamination markers before every sample.

timing_metrics.start: Begin cleanup with the exact manifest allowlist after the session reaches terminal state.
timing_metrics.end: Every manifest-owned mutable resource is absent or recorded as a precise orphan; immutable base digest remains unchanged.
timing_metrics.preparation: Create one complete experiment-owned candidate lifecycle before every sample.

timing_metrics.start: Begin local import or provider-side clone of an already approved locally/provider-present digest; network transfer is excluded.
timing_metrics.end: The new immutable digest is available and validates without changing the prior base.
timing_metrics.preparation: Remove only the prior experiment import while retaining both approved source digests before every sample.

one_shot_distribution_observation.purpose: Record bytes, duration, source, authentication mode, and rollback for one separately approved image distribution/update without pretending one observation is a distribution.

correctness_probes.pattern: ten A-to-B and ten B-to-A handoffs in deterministic alternation
correctness_probes.pass: Zero prior-namespace workspace, HOME, TMPDIR, DerivedData, installed-app data, preferences, keychain canary names, or lease identifiers are observable; no canary values are persisted.
Zero worker-instance, writable-path, simulator, device-set, reservation, namespace, or lease collision and zero cross-namespace writable observation.

correctness_probes.levels: Exact ascending integer list starts at 1, includes 2, is capped at 4, and is frozen in the approved execution manifest.
stop_conditions: free RAM below the manifest minimum
host thermal-pressure signal reaches the manifest stop level
disk free space below the manifest minimum
correctness_probes.reporting: Report the highest clean tested level and first failing or safety-stopped level. Below two selects the serialized classification; do not extrapolate beyond the cap.

correctness_probes.repetitions: before and after every candidate sample set
correctness_probes.pass: Base image or template digest is byte-identical; mutable clones are never promoted implicitly.
New digest is admitted only after attestation; mismatch returns to the prior digest without deleting it and leaves no unowned clone.

failure_recovery_probes.pass: Loss is recorded; clone is not reused; a clean compatible clone can retry without base mutation.
Lease becomes lost; no report is produced from the lost session; a clean session can retry.
Cleanup is durable and completes within the W3 30-second deadline or records exact orphans.
Resources are reclaimed no later than lease TTL plus 30 seconds or recorded as exact orphans.

decision_branches.select_when: A VM candidate passes all hard gates and both warm p95 budgets with reusable worker and disposable workspace/session separation.
VM isolation/recovery passes but safe reuse inside one VM fails or per-node/session overhead requires namespace lifetime.
Only the trusted native candidate passes latency and reset gates; report its lower attained reproducibility honestly.
Local VM/native candidates cannot meet correctness or operations gates but an external target provides a reproducible coarse lifecycle.
At least one candidate is credible at concurrency one but no candidate safely reaches two.
No exercised candidate provides a bounded credible native-mobile path, or immutable/reset/cleanup hard gates fail.
